name: cryptopunks-daily-floor
title: CryptoPunks daily floor price, 2017 to today
description: Lowest public ask on the CryptoPunks marketplace contract at the end of each UTC day, rebuilt from the contract's own events, plus the PunkStrategy (PNKSTR) premium to its treasury.

fields.name: floor_eth
fields.description: Lowest public ask at 23:59:59 UTC, in ETH

fields.name: floor_usd
fields.description: floor_eth x eth_usd, rounded to cents

fields.name: eth_usd
fields.description: ETH price in USD at 23:59:59 UTC (DefiLlama)

fields.name: floor_punk_index
fields.description: Punk offered at the floor price (one of them on ties)

fields.name: active_asks
fields.description: All open offers on the contract, public and private

fields.name: source
fields.description: Whether the contract saw marketplace activity that day

fields.name: asset_fmv_usd
fields.description: Punks held x floor x ETH/USD + unallocated ETH x ETH/USD
